summary: Read the third receipt (b6089b103bbb467199d051f4492e82c8, exit 0, both cases passed): with every comparison scoped by tag, all five now evaluate completely and hold — trimmed case repeated_snapshot_installs true, victim_not_caught_up true and stale_claim_persists true on the probe at index 14 (FSM restored 5 -> 1255 times in 3s at an unchanged snapshot index of 83, applied index fixed at 83 while the cluster frontier reached 95, cached claim still (98, term 2), store suffix 84-98 kept, commit index 0, one stable leader set), with the untrimmed control negative on both install count and progress at index 29. The question account is therefore recorded as explained / defect_claim asserted on a decided comparison set, citing all three receipts and keeping the trigger attribution, the claim-boundary guess and the unmeasured vote-side consequence explicit. To resolve the two limits that account still states, the harness was extended and two boundary cases requested: a monotonic-store variant of the trimmed case (expected to stall with the log store emptied while the cached claim survives) and a repair-boundary case that drives the leader's applied index past the follower's claim and publishes a snapshot above it (expected to end the stall once the snapshot index exceeds the claim). The earlier cases are kept in the file but only the two new ones are selected; local construction runs of both behaved as predicted (monotonic: restores 5 -> 1283, applied fixed at 83, store empty, claim persisting; repair: stall present before the intervention, claim 96, new snapshot at 97, follower then applied 83 -> 108 with claim (108, term 3)). Incomplete: the retained receipts for those two boundary cases, plus the vote-side consequence, larger clusters, longer windows and a production BoltDB-style monotonic store remain open.
